info.trera.cargo_station: Automated aerial logistics hub with 6 drone landing bays, 27 outbound slots, and 27 storage slots. Install an RF Chip (I–III for 256 / 512 / 1,024 block range) and Transport or Heavy Transport Drones, configure a target Cargo Station, and supply EU (LV base, 14,400 EU) or Single-Use Batteries. Accepts Machinera machine upgrades and Transitera Chunk Loading Upgrades.
info.trera.chunk_loading_upgrade: Installs into a Smart Port or Cargo Station upgrade slot to force-load a 3x3 chunk area around the station while powered. Draws 2 EU/t standby and automatically releases forced chunks if EU runs out.
info.trera.comm_base_station: The Communication Base Station links adjacent Smart Ports and Cargo Stations to the remote control network. Accepts both EU and FE (1 EU = 4 FE; 4,000 EU / 16,000 FE capacity, LV 32 EU/t) with a 2 EU/t (8 FE/t) standby drain. Right-click with an Operation Terminal to bind, sneak-right-click to unbind, or right-click without a terminal to inspect power and linked stations.
info.trera.electric_cargo_boat: 54-slot autonomous electric cargo vessel for Smart Ports. Place in navigable water adjacent to a Smart Port berth; sneak-right-click when docked to inspect its cargo hold or right-click before launch to ride along.
info.trera.heavy_transport_drone: Armored heavy-lift drone for Cargo Stations with 36 cargo slots and 10 blocks/s cruise speed. Consumes 2x the dispatch energy of a Standard Transport Drone (1,600 / 4,000 / 14,000 EU by Manhattan distance).
info.trera.operation_terminal: The Operation Terminal remotely manages bound Communication Base Stations and their adjacent logistics stations anywhere in the same dimension (requires loaded chunks and powered base stations). Right-click a Comm Base Station to bind, sneak-right-click or use the list to unbind, and right-click air/other blocks or press the hotkey (default G) to open the selection screen. Rechargeable via Machinera EU or FE chargers (10,000 EU / 40,000 FE capacity, LV 32 EU/t). Viewing and configuring is free; only successful remote launches cost 100 EU (400 FE). Equippable in Curios charm or belt slots.
info.trera.rf_chip: Required in a Cargo Station's RF Chip slot to authorize drone dispatches. Tier I reaches 256 blocks, Tier II reaches 512 blocks, and Tier III reaches 1,024 blocks (Manhattan distance).
info.trera.smart_port: Automated maritime dock with 27 outbound slots and 27 storage slots for Electric Smart Cargo Boats. Requires a navigable water channel to the target Smart Port and 3,000 EU (or 2 Single-Use Batteries) per one-way dispatch (2x with Auto-Return). Accepts Machinera machine upgrades and Transitera Chunk Loading Upgrades.
info.trera.transport_drone: Fast light-lift drone for Cargo Stations with 12 cargo slots and 16 blocks/s cruise speed. Dispatch energy scales by Manhattan distance: 800 EU (<=256m), 2,000 EU (257–512m), or 7,000 EU (513–1,024m).
